target_venue: Journal of Engineering and Applied Science

papers.title: Performance analysis of deep learning-based object detection algorithms on COCO benchmark: a comparative study
papers.goal: Compare object-detection algorithms on a standard benchmark using a common family of performance metrics.
papers.intended_users: engineers selecting object detectors for smart-city applications
papers.decision_enabled: select a model using accuracy, object-size, and real-time performance criteria
papers.evidence_shape: comparative analysis on a public benchmark
papers.relevance_to_dyfi: Direct venue precedent for a performance-analysis paper whose contribution is the reliability and interpretation of a common evaluation setting rather than a new physical discovery.

papers.title: Unconfined compressive strength prediction of rock materials based on machine learning
papers.goal: Evaluate predictors of rock unconfined compressive strength when direct measurement is costly.
papers.decision_enabled: choose a predictive model for an expensive engineering property
papers.evidence_shape: multiple models evaluated on a documented engineering dataset
papers.relevance_to_dyfi: Demonstrates that the venue accepts geoscience-adjacent machine-learning comparison when the engineering task and user are explicit.

papers.title: A hybrid machine learning method of support vector regression with particle swarm optimization for predicting IRI in continuously reinforced concrete pavement
papers.goal: Predict pavement roughness for maintenance planning and compare the proposed model with declared baselines.
papers.decision_enabled: select a model for pavement-condition prediction
papers.evidence_shape: common-fold comparison of four machine-learning models
papers.relevance_to_dyfi: Shows the venue expects the model-selection decision and engineering use to be stated directly.

papers.title: Response of Aswan cable-stayed bridge to spatial non-synchronous seismic excitations
papers.goal: Quantify how spatially non-synchronous earthquake excitation changes bridge-response parameters.
papers.decision_enabled: interpret spatial-variability effects in seismic design assessment
papers.evidence_shape: nonlinear time-history analysis using multiple earthquake records
papers.relevance_to_dyfi: Establishes an earthquake-related readership, while also showing that domain papers are expected to state the engineering quantity and decision affected.

papers.title: Pseudo-static analytical formulation for seismic thrust on cantilever retaining walls in C-Φ soils considering double failure planes
papers.goal: Improve estimation of active seismic thrust for retaining-wall configurations omitted by classical formulations.
papers.decision_enabled: estimate seismic design thrust over a wider valid range
papers.evidence_shape: analytical derivation validated against numerical modelling
papers.relevance_to_dyfi: Calibrates the venue's expectation that a method paper names the invalid decision it corrects and validates the correction.

conclusion.binding_lesson: The retarget must combine the benchmark precedent's explicit comparison task with the seismic papers' explicit engineering decision; topical overlap alone is insufficient.
